Problem: A 10-by-12-inch page has margins of 1.5 inches on all sides. What fraction of the area of the page is taken up by the margins? Express your answer as a common fraction.

Solve step by step. End with: The answer is [your answer].

message.content:
The page area is:

\(10 \times 12 = 120\) square inches.

The margins are \(1.5\) inches on all sides, so the non-margin area has dimensions:

\[
10 - 1.5 - 1.5 = 7
\]

\[
12 - 1.5 - 1.5 = 9
\]

So the non-margin area is:

\[
7 \times 9 = 63
\]

Thus the margin area is:

\[
120 - 63 = 57
\]

The fraction of the page taken up by margins is:

\[
\frac{57}{120} = \frac{19}{40}
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{\frac{19}{40}}\).
